reproduction.failure: Focused wide-row centers from index5 are covered by the floating selection toolbar. The short title child on the left was uncovered; no short-title failure is claimed.
reproduction.rapidFailure: After the TrackTable fix, a separate native 20-key rapid burst from row0 reaches row15 because VirtualSongs defers all focus by RAF. The later final app reaches row20 with exactly20 Down events.

implementation: TrackTable reveals only an active keyboard-visible row and its children, using actual header/main scroll padding, selection toolbar, player and notice bounds. Layout observers account for toolbar/notice/viewport changes. No focus or selection is assigned by this effect.
VirtualSongs focuses a mounted target immediately. Its absent-target RAF fallback checks the connected originating focus and matching row key, and cancels on a newer request or unmount.

pairedDecision.Steve: Revised to shared TrackTable geometry after challenge of toolbar CSS measurement timing. Keyboard-only reveal; inspect long metadata and ordinary tables.
pairedDecision.Elena: Supports shared actual geometry after challenge; actual TrackTable diff reviewed without actionable finding. Later synchronous mounted-row focus accepted with guarded fallback, and actual VirtualSongs diff reviewed without actionable finding.
pairedDecision.Morgan: Use the existing shared table and DOM geometry; no global CSS or new dependency. The rapid-repeat correction follows native reproduction.

fixture.network: Only local127.0.0.1:5191 catalog. Nonlocal requests blocked; mutation guard permits only fixture sign-in. No real credentials or provider requests.
fixture.storage: Actual isolated safeStorage and main services; shared Keychain adapter returns null. Scheduler stopped and silent local audio muted.
fixture.mainInstrumentation: Read-state faults after sender/input guards; a previously added recovery-phase setter is inactive here. Playback notice is an intentional preparePlayback fail, not a real service failure.
fixture.data: 20,000 songs,2,000 albums,two libraries. Initial cases use short metadata and default3-song playlists. Final cases use long synthetic song names and30-song fixture playlists.
fixture.ownedProcesses: All four observer runs exited0; original and long-metadata local servers stopped after verification.

measurementCorrections: Initial one-RAF focus telemetry ran before the reveal callback and reported pre-correction coverage, despite the inspected native screenshot showing a clear row. Preserve that result as timing-only; corrected observer uses two RAFs plus settled100ms current geometry.

Two-RAF telemetry intentionally omits targets that have already lost focus during a rapid burst. Rapid correctness uses native key counts and settled final row/selection, not a claim that every transient target was sampled.

A native accessibility click on album text did not select a row and focused the document. It is excluded as a pointer-selection pass. The subsequent real checkbox click selected index21 in addition to20 and kept scrollTop878.
freshness: Nine intermediate cases have the final TrackTable bytes and predate only the VirtualSongs mounted-focus correction. Seven later cases use both final source files. Final build includes TypeScript and full ESLint, both exit0.
limitations: Q06 remains Review for app-wide control/conditional-state reconciliation. These local checks do not prove VoiceOver, uncoached usability, physical media keys, display-scale combinations, live provider behavior or audible quality.
Overlay and background guards are source-reviewed; opening/dismissing a menu is observed, but no separate held-background-refresh overlay stress pass is claimed.
Native screenshots were inspected inline; no new screenshot file is attached.
Smaller-than1280×720 and enlarged app zoom remain deferred.
